text: Ne slažem se. Ovaj rok nije realan.
note: Direct disagreement alone is not a defect.

text: Možda bih samo hteo da kažem da mi se čini da možda ovaj rok ipak nije baš potpuno realan.
note: Do not mechanically shorten; review whether stacked mitigation matches speaker, relationship and stakes.

text: Pa, mislim da nije baš tako.
note: Pa/mislim can carry stance and mitigation; they are not filler by default.

text: Ma daj, Ana, znaš da nisam to mislio.
note: Particles, vocative and znaš encode relationship/force.

text: Možeš li da mi pošalješ ugovor?
note: No automatic error: adequacy depends on established relationship and institutional context.

text: Pitao sam se da li biste možda bili voljni da razmotrite mogućnost da pomerimo sastanak.
note: Possible English-style over-indirection, but high-stakes/formal context can justify it.

text: Ne. Čekaj, zapravo mislim da si u pravu.
note: Do not delete čekaj/mislim merely to make prose concise.
Could be sincere or ironic; wording alone is insufficient.
